name: Manifold Markets API
summary: Free REST API for Manifold, a play-money prediction market: questions, probabilities, bets, comments, users and topics.
description: Public GET endpoints list and search markets (binary, multiple choice, numeric and perpetual markets), return probabilities, bets, comments, positions, users and topics (groups). Reads need no key; placing bets or creating markets needs an API key from the user profile. Times are Unix milliseconds.

auth.notes: Reads need no auth. Writes use 'Authorization: Key {api_key}' as the docs describe (not tested here).

rate_limit.summary: 500 requests per minute per IP, per the docs.

license.name: Manifold Terms of Service (API licensing section)

agent_notes: Page /markets backwards with before=<last id>. Use /search-markets for topic search and /market/{id} for the full object (answers, pool). outcomeType varies (BINARY, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, PERP and others), so check it before reading probability. Currency is play-money mana, not dollars.
caveats: The docs state that using API data to train AI/ML models for commercial purposes requires a data license from Manifold; research and non-commercial use are permitted.
Scraping outside the API and circumventing the rate limit are prohibited by the terms summary in the docs.
The old host manifold.markets/api is being retired in favour of api.manifold.markets.

verification.notes: Example executed without a key. /search-markets, /slug/{slug} and /market/{id} also returned 200; CORS * seen on /markets.
